problems: kannauj-varman-dynasty is extended to 725..816 (Cliopatria 732..771) because the Ayudha page has the Ayudhas replace the Varmans at Kannauj in 770 and hold it to Nagabhata II's 816 capture; one Kannauj state with a rename event. The 772-815 keyframe (Kannauj 150 km plus the Doab) and the 771 loss are confidence-1 minimal readings. Cut them and set the end to 771 if the Cliopatria life is preferred (see the notes file).

Cliopatria's Pratihara row has shapes the pages contradict: Kannauj, Doab and Awadh before 816 (772, 778, 783, 806), Bihar and Magadha in the 783 maximum of 0.92 M km2, no Kannauj in 825-839 and 840-849, Kannauj lost c. 916 not 922, and the row ends 1039 though the last ruler dies 1036; also Saurashtra and Sindh before 860.
The Gurjara-Pratihara dossier has 15 of 31 events at confidence 1 because the pages opened are silent on most 8th-century and 10th-century land changes; the reviewer should read them as gaps.

WebFetch returns a model summary of each page, not the page text: quotation marks in the dossiers are limited to wording the tool marked as quoted, and the other statements are paraphrases (pages disagree internally in places, listed in the notes file).
Page budget: 9 pages for the Pratihara state plus the Kannauj article shared with the Kannauj dossier (10 sources listed); 5 pages for Kannauj, one of them (Tripartite Struggle) shared.
